what: Beside a sticky About slot, a photo hidden at upper-left (−10vh, −30vh) and tilted −6° flies in one at a time over .5s power1.out for each slot-height scrolled down. It settles upright and stacks over the previous one, then after its range passes it tilts slightly the other way to 3° over .5s. Scrolling back reverses it and it flies off and vanishes — wide screens only (1025px and above)

options.x: Starting horizontal position of the fly-in, default -10vh
options.y: Starting vertical position of the fly-in, default -30vh
options.lean: Tilt angle (deg) of a section once it passes the range, default 3
options.dur: Flight length (sec), default .5 (the original gives no length, so the GSAP default applies)
options.min: Flies only at this width (px) or above, default 1025 — 0 means always
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photos to fly in (two or more — one segment each, in order). The height of the element (cell) the part is attached to is one segment

note: Cells must be sticky so a photo stacks in each segment — make the section holding the cells (photo count + 1) × cell height

from.where: index.js .ky-thought__main [data-thought-fig] — original .top-thought__main pinned cell (100svh, section 300svh) with two photos, start top+=Height×i center · end bottom+=Height×i center · toggleActions play none none reverse · onLeave rotate 3deg .5s, 1025px and up
